target_customer: Sales teams, agencies and enterprises that sell to local and small businesses
problem: Reaching local businesses is hard because data on them is scattered across maps, filings, reviews and websites and goes stale.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for a local business database with enrichment and API
product_category: Local business data and sales intelligence

founders.name: Richard He
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior software engineer at Cruise, founding engineer at Graft, contributed to LangChain and created the Chrome-GPT agent.

founders.name: Kathryn Wu
founders.background_notes: Worked in growth at Pinterest per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and refreshing data on millions of businesses from public sources needs scraping and entity resolution at scale, but uses standard techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Data is built from public sources so rivals can rebuild it. Freshness and coverage are the edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources. Large data vendors exist but the local business niche is the wedge.

market_need_then: Press frames it as an alternative to ZoomInfo for sales leads on local businesses. The company claims over 10,000 companies use it. No dated demand evidence beyond that was collected.

branding.domain_note: Started on openmart.ai and upgraded to the exact match openmart.com around the August 2024 seed announcement, per a domain broker blog (secondary source).

identity.visual_style: Product led layout with data tables and UI mockups
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, metric led copy with AI intelligence framing

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt and Forbes badges shown on its site, plus TechCrunch coverage of the seed.

brand_strength.rationale: Some press and a Clay integration, but no evidence of a distinct brand asset. Name resembles OpenMarket and other open marketplace names.

outcome_analysis: Openmart is active, raised a 2.75M seed in August 2024 after YC Winter 2024 and claims over 10,000 customer companies. It has since broadened from a lead database to enrichment, an API and an AI sales agent. Funding after the seed was not found, so growth after 2024 is not verified.
notes: Seed amount cross checked by TechCrunch, a domain broker post and aggregators, which give 2.75M, 2.8M and 3M. An earlier 500K seed in Oct 2023 appears only on one aggregator and is unverified. A 15.2M total on an AI profile site is uncorroborated. Competitor searches returned only 2026 comparison pages so the dated list is empty. Founder education not found.
